article.story: MILWAUKEE -- — Amar Augillard scored 28 points as Milwaukee beat IU Indianapolis 95-83 on Sunday. Augillard added seven rebounds for the Panthers (8-10, 4-3 Horizon League). Josh Dixon scored 20 points on 7-for-11 shooting with four 3-pointers. Aaron Franklin posted a double-double with 19 points and 14 rebounds. Kyler D'Augustino had 24 points to lead the Jaguars (4-15, 0-8), who have lost six in a row. Maguire Mitchell added 19 points and six rebounds. Micah Davis finished with 15 points, four assists and four steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
